approach: Add a Priority enum (High, Normal, Low; derived Ord, High first) to plan.rs with Priority::from_text reading a case-insensitive 'Priority: <level>' line, and a priority field on PlanEntry (Normal in bare). Plan::build sorts each ready wave by (priority, rung, age); the wave loop is untouched so dependencies still win. reading::plan_entry sets priority from the request text. JobLine gains a priority string filled in status::job_line from the same parser. display::plan prints a priority line per item; status open/recent lines get a priority suffix. Add tests, a CHANGELOG entry and a decisions.md entry.

decisions.choice: Priority is the first sort key within a ready wave: (priority, rung, age); wave loop unchanged.
decisions.reason: Smallest change; priority before age while dependencies stay first.

rejected.option: Boost dependencies of a high item transitively
rejected.why: Changes dependency semantics; out of scope.
The cutover request would still sit behind older higher-rung work.

decisions.choice: Read priority from a 'Priority: <level>' line via one shared parser Priority::from_text used by plan_entry and status.
decisions.reason: No new command or stored field; one parser keeps plan and status consistent.

rejected.why: Needs new command and record schema; out of scope. Recorded in decisions.md.

decisions.choice: Closed set high/normal/low; unknown or missing gives Normal; first valid line wins.
decisions.reason: A typo must not reorder the queue; default keeps today's order.

files.purpose: Priority enum and parser, PlanEntry.priority, sort key, module doc, tests.
plan_entry sets priority from request text; test.
Priority line in plan items; priority suffix in status lines; test.
Plan display test covers priority lines and high item first.
Decision entry with alternatives and cutover motivation.

steps: Read the tails of CHANGELOG.md and docs/decisions.md for format and next decision number.
In plan.rs add Priority (High, Normal, Low; derives incl. Ord, Serialize kebab-case; as_str; from_text), PlanEntry.priority (Normal in bare), sort key (priority, rung, age), module doc update.
Add plan.rs tests: high newest first, dependency beats priority, no-priority order unchanged, low last, parser cases.
In reading.rs plan_entry set priority from the text; add test.
In status.rs add priority to JobLine, set in job_line.
In display.rs add priority line in entry_lines and suffix on status lines; add test.
Run cargo fmt, cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings, cargo test --locked.

risks.mitigation: Add priority as a separate line in plan and a suffix in status; run full cargo test.

risks.risk: Derived Ord puts wrong end first.
risks.mitigation: Variant order High, Normal, Low; test asserts it.

risks.risk: Prose mentioning priority reorders the queue.
risks.mitigation: Only a line starting with 'Priority:' and an exact level counts; tested.

risks.risk: PlanEntry literals break on new field.

demonstrations.method: Unit test in plan.rs: n1,n2,n3 normal plus newer high h, same rung, no dependencies; assert Plan::build order.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the priority sort key the newer high entry is last and the order assertion fails.

demonstrations.method: Unit test: h high depends_on older normal n1, plus unrelated normal n2; assert position(n1) < position(h).
demonstrations.fails_without: If priority overrode dependencies, h would precede n1 and the test fails.

demonstrations.method: New plan.rs test with no priorities, varied rungs and ages, asserting rung-then-age order; existing plan and drain tests run unchanged.
demonstrations.observes: Order is rung then age; all tests pass.
demonstrations.fails_without: If the default order changed, the no-priority test and existing tests fail.

demonstrations.method: drain.rs plan display test with a high and a normal entry asserts 'priority' lines for both; display.rs test builds a JobLine with priority high and asserts the status line contains 'priority high'.
demonstrations.observes: Plan output has a priority line per item; status lines show priority.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the display change the priority needles are absent and assertions fail.

demonstrations.method: Tests for Priority::from_text ('Priority: high', 'priority: HIGH', indented, absent, 'Priority: urgent') and reading::plan_entry on a request with the line.
demonstrations.observes: High for the line in any case; Normal otherwise.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the parser every request reads as normal and the high assertions fail.

demonstrations.observes: The Order bullet names priority, then rung, then age, with dependencies first.
A CHANGELOG entry for request priority; a decisions.md entry with words-in-request versus command-field alternatives and the 2026-10-24 cutover motivation.

demonstrations.method: Run clippy with warnings denied, then cargo fmt --all --check, over the code including the new tests and field.
demonstrations.observes: No warnings and no formatting diff; both exit 0.
demonstrations.fails_without: An unused item, an unformatted line or a missed Priority field in a struct literal would make clippy or fmt exit non-zero, failing the criterion.
